question: 两股等密度冷电子束(各 n₀=5e26 m⁻³,总密度 n=1e27 m⁻³)以相对速度 v₀=2.6e+06 m/s 对穿。冷双流不稳定性最大增长率 γ_max=ω_pe/2(ω_pe 按总密度计算)约为多少(s⁻¹)?常数:e=1.6022e-19 C,ε₀=8.8542e-12,m_e=9.1094e-31 kg。

metadata.source: 冷双流不稳定性(公开教科书,NRL Formulary)
metadata.notes: 对称束最大增长率 ωpe/2

question_en: Two cold electron beams of equal density (each with n₀=5e26 m⁻³, total density n=1e27 m⁻³) counterpropagate at a relative velocity v₀=2.6e+06 m/s. What is the approximate value of the maximum growth rate of the cold two-stream instability γ_max=ω_pe/2 (where ω_pe is calculated using the total density) in s⁻¹? Constants: e=1.6022e-19 C, ε₀=8.8542e-12, m_e=9.1094e-31 kg.

question: 尾隆(bump-on-tail)不稳定性中,共振条件 v_φ=ω/k 落在分布函数正斜率区。估计等离子体电子热速度量级 v_t=√(k_BT/m_e)(取 T_e=2.9 keV)作为共振速度量级(m/s)。

metadata.source: Landau 共振与热速度(NRL Formulary)

question_en: In the bump-on-tail instability, the resonance condition \( v_\varphi = \omega/k \) lies in the positive slope region of the distribution function. Estimate the order of magnitude of the plasma electron thermal velocity \( v_t = \sqrt{k_B T/m_e} \) (take \( T_e = 2.9 \, \text{keV} \)) as the order of magnitude of the resonance velocity (m/s).
